desc: Formalize fixed-S feasibility: S >= maxKnownA and S >= maxKnownB, and M(S) = sum_v min(cntA[v], cntB[S-v]) >= K = KA + KB - N (K<=0 trivially satisfied).
Prove only multisets matter (A permutable) and unknown-count feasibility reduces to M(S) >= K.
Candidate set: if K <= 0 answer Yes; else M(S) >= 1 forces S = a + b for known A a and known B b.
Implement O(N^2) accumulator: acc[v+w] += min(cntA[v], cntB[w]) over distinct pairs; accept S >= thresh with acc[S] >= K.
Validate on Samples 1-3 (Yes/No/No) and edge cases (all -1, K<=0, duplicates, maxA+maxB candidate).
Confirm complexity O(N^2) <= 4e6 and finalize stdin/stdout program (all public samples passed).
